q1.explanationZh: AIDS 是“艾滋病”的缩写，也可写作 Aids，是名词。

q2.explanationZh: aim 可作动词“瞄准；旨在”，也可作名词“目标”；aim at“瞄准；旨在”。

q3.explanationZh: air 名词“空气；空中”，by air“乘飞机”；作动词还可表示“使公开”。

q4.explanationZh: air-conditioned 是合成形容词“装有空调的”，中间要用连字符。

q5.explanationZh: aircraft = air + craft，泛指各种航空器，单复数同形。

q7.explanationZh: airmail = air + mail，“航空邮件”，by airmail“用航空邮寄”。

q9.explanationZh: alarm 作名词“警报；闹铃”，作动词“使惊恐”；alarm clock“闹钟”。

q10.explanationZh: album 名词“相册；音乐专辑”，photo album“相册”。

q11.explanationZh: alcohol“酒；酒精”，形容词 alcoholic“酒精的”。

q12.explanationZh: alert 可作形容词、动词和名词，be alert to“对……保持警惕”。

q13.explanationZh: alike 作形容词时一般作表语，不放在名词前，如 They are alike。

q14.explanationZh: alive“活着的”，一般作表语或后置定语。

q15.explanationZh: all 可作形容词、代词和名词，表示“全部；一切”，指三者或三者以上。

q16.explanationZh: allow“允许”，常用 allow doing 或 allow sb. to do。

q17.explanationZh: allow 加 -ance 构成名词 allowance“津贴；零用钱”。

q18.explanationZh: almost 副词“几乎”，可与 no、none、nothing 等连用。

q19.explanationZh: alone 表示“仅”时放在名词或代词后，如 the book alone；也可表示“单独的；独自地”。

q20.explanationZh: along 作介词“沿着”，作副词“向前；一起”。

q22.explanationZh: aloud 指“出声地”，read aloud“朗读”。

q23.explanationZh: alphabet“字母表”，注意 ph 读 /f/。

q24.explanationZh: already“已经”，常用于肯定句和现在完成时。

q25.explanationZh: also“也；还”，一般放在实义动词前、be 动词或助动词后。

q26.explanationZh: alter“改变”，指部分地改变、修改。

q27.explanationZh: alternative 作形容词“供选择的”，作名词“选择”；have no alternative but to do“别无选择只好做”。

q28.explanationZh: although“虽然”，同一句中不能再用 but。

q29.explanationZh: altogether 是一个词，表示“总共；完全”；all together 是两个词，表示“一起”。

q30.explanationZh: always 副词“总是”，常与一般现在时连用。

q31.explanationZh: a.m. 表示“上午”，放在钟点之后，如 10:00 a.m.。

q32.explanationZh: aim at“瞄准；旨在，争取”，at 后接名词或动名词。

q33.explanationZh: leave/let sb. alone“别打扰某人”，alone 作宾语补足语。

q34.explanationZh: leave/let sth. alone“别碰某物，别管某事”。

q35.explanationZh: “寄航空邮件”= send a letter by airmail，by 表示方式。

q36.explanationZh: “禁止”= prohibit，“酒的销售”= the sale of alcohol。

q37.explanationZh: above all“最重要的是；尤其是”。

q39.explanationZh: all in all“总的说来，一般说来”。

q40.explanationZh: all over“到处，遍及”，如 all over the world。

q41.explanationZh: all together 是两个词，“一起；同时”；注意与 altogether“总共；完全”区分。

q43.explanationZh: not at all“一点也不”，也可用来回答感谢：“别客气”。

q44.explanationZh: worst of all“最糟糕的是”，worst 是 bad 的最高级。

q45.explanationZh: allow 后接动名词：allow doing“允许做某事”。

q46.explanationZh: allow sb. to do“允许某人做某事”，to 不能省略。

q47.explanationZh: alive 可作宾语补足语，save sb. alive“救活某人”。

q48.explanationZh: not altogether“并不完全”，altogether 是副词，修饰形容词 sure。

q49.explanationZh: “虽然她累了”，用连词 although 引导让步状语从句。

q51.explanationZh: almost no one“几乎没有人”，与 no 连用只能用 almost；句首首字母大写。

q52.explanationZh: It is known to all that...“众所周知……”，all 作代词“所有人”。

q53.explanationZh: be alike“相像”，alike 一般作表语，very much 修饰它。

q54.explanationZh: allow sb. to do“允许某人做某事”；讲过去的事用过去式 allowed。

q55.explanationZh: have no alternative but to do“别无选择，只能做……”。

q56.explanationZh: short-term aims“短期目标”，one after another 表示多个，用复数 aims。

q57.sampleAnswer: The authorities were alerted to the danger.
references: The authorities were alerted to the danger.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q57.explanationZh: “使警惕”用动词 alert，be alerted to“对……警觉起来”；“当局”= the authorities。

q58.sampleAnswer: The book alone will bring him lasting reputation.
references: The book alone will bring him lasting reputation.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: alone 放在名词后表示“仅仅”：the book alone；“流芳百世”可译为 lasting reputation。

q59.sampleAnswer: Almost all students are busy preparing for the coming final exam.
references: Almost all students are busy preparing for the coming final exam.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “几乎所有的学生”= almost all students；“忙着做某事”= be busy doing sth.。

q60.sampleAnswer: Please allow me to tell an interesting story before the lesson.
references: Please allow me to tell an interesting story before the lesson.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “允许某人做某事”= allow sb. to do sth.。

q61.sampleAnswer: The factory will aim at increasing production next year.
references: The factory will aim at increasing production next year.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “以……为目标”= aim at，at 是介词，后接动名词 increasing。

q62.sampleAnswer: Not until he went out of the air-conditioned room did he realize how cold it was.
references: Not until he went out of the air-conditioned room did he realize how cold it was.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “直到……才……”用 Not until... 放句首，主句部分倒装；“空调房间”= the air-conditioned room。

q63.sampleAnswer: The album reminded her of the days when she was free from all worries.
references: The album reminded her of the days when she was free from all worries.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “让某人想起”= remind sb. of；“无忧无虑”= free from all worries。

q64.sampleAnswer: Only when the government takes serious measures can we expect the real improvement in air quality.
references: Only when the government takes serious measures can we expect the real improvement in air quality.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “只有……才……”用 Only when... 放句首，主句部分倒装；“空气质量”= air quality。

q65.sampleAnswer: There is no need for you to tell me the truth, for I have already known it.
references: There is no need for you to tell me the truth, for I have already known it.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “没必要”= there is no need for sb. to do；“已经知道”用现在完成时 have already known。

q66.sampleAnswer: Although this product is in favor of environmental protection, few people show interest in it because of its high price.
references: Although this product is in favor of environmental protection, few people show interest in it because of its high price.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “虽然……”用 although，句中不能再用 but；“几乎无人”= few people。
